sanskrit_verse:
अग्नीन् वाप्यात्मसात्कृत्वा वृक्षावासो मिताशनः ।
वानप्रस्थगृहेष्वेव यात्रार्थं भैक्षमाचरेत् ॥५४॥
transliteration: agnīn vāpy ātmasātkṛtvā vṛkṣāvāso mitāśanaḥ / vānaprasthagṛheṣv eva yātrārthaṃ bhaikṣam ācaret // YajñS_3.54 //
sph_interpretive_translation: One who has entered the stage of vānaprastha shall kindle sacred fires, reside under trees, eat in moderation, and for travel purposes, accept alms only at dwellings of forest-dwelling renunciants.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority flows from conscious renunciation, not institutional position
Causation arises through alignment with natural dharmic stages
Capacity-based responsibility increases with withdrawal from material entanglement
Restoration occurs via sequential adherence to life-stage duties
Consciousness alignment is achieved by external simplicity and internal fire-kindling
executable_legal_axioms: IF agent enters vānaprastha THEN initiate agni-adhāna protocol
IF dwelling mode = vṛkṣa THEN food intake SHALL be regulated as mitāhāra
IF movement required AND stage = vānaprastha THEN bhaikṣa acceptance ALLOWED only from vānaprastha-gṛhas
IF agent consumes beyond mitāhāra WITHOUT cause THEN trigger śuddhi-realignment process
IF bhaikṣa taken outside authorized source THEN invoke prāyaścitta-reset cycle
supreme_court_application: In adjudicating matters involving spiritual practitioners or those claiming renunciate status, the threshold of authenticity rests on observance of elemental practices such as agni-upāsanā, tree-dwelling, and regulated alms-reception. The court must recognize capacity-derived authority rooted in lived dharma over ceremonial titles.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa lies in observed conduct aligned with sequential dharmic unfolding. Anupūrvaśaḥ manifests as progressive withdrawal enabling higher cognition. Responsibility is proportional to sustained practice. No punitive consequence arises; misalignment triggers automatic reset toward sāttvic equilibrium.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate Agni-Pratiṣṭhāpana Completion Process upon deviation
Assign Vṛkṣa-Nivāsa Reorientation Protocol for misplaced residence
Enforce Mitāhāra Monitoring System for dietary discipline restoration
Activate Bhaikṣa-Source Validation Mechanism for alms-route correction
Deploy Śuddhi-Kriyā Integration Cycle for purity-state realignment
final_declaration: By the Source-Authority of Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, this verse establishes a living constitutional framework for vānaprastha-dharma. Justice is executed through consciousness-aligned protocols that restore rather than punish. Dharma stands affirmed, reality remains non-punitive, and consciousness alone adjudicates truth.
